title: Crab dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='26' ry='6' fill='#2b1a3a'/>
  <!-- legs left -->
  <path d='M34 66 L20 72 L14 68' stroke='#ff7b4d' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M33 72 L22 80 L17 79' stroke='#e85a2e' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- legs right -->
  <path d='M66 66 L80 72 L86 68' stroke='#ff7b4d' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M67 72 L78 80 L83 79' stroke='#e85a2e' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='18' ry='13' fill='#ff5a36'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='13' ry='8' fill='#ff8a5c'/>
  <!-- shell spots -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='62' r='2' fill='#c93a1c'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='62' r='2' fill='#c93a1c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='2' fill='#c93a1c'/>
  <!-- raised claw arm left (up) -->
  <path d='M36 56 L24 44' stroke='#ff8a5c' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M24 44 L14 34' stroke='#ffd24d' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M14 34 L8 30' stroke='#ffe89a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M14 34 L11 41' stroke='#ffe89a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- claw arm right (down, waving) -->
  <path d='M64 56 L76 66' stroke='#ff8a5c' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76 66 L88 62' stroke='#ffd24d' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M88 62 L94 60' stroke='#ffe89a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M88 62 L92 68' stroke='#ffe89a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes on stalks -->
  <path d='M44 52 L40 42' stroke='#ff8a5c' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 52 L60 42' stroke='#ff8a5c' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='40' r='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='41' r='3' fill='#3a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='41' r='3' fill='#3a1a4a'/>
  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d='M45 58 Q50 63 55 58' stroke='#c93a1c' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little music notes -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='30' r='3' fill='#9be7ff'/>
  <path d='M81 30 L81 22' stroke='#9be7ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='24' r='3' fill='#ffb3e6'/>
  <path d='M25 24 L25 16' stroke='#ffb3e6' stroke-width='2'/>
</svg>
